xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4642: Cite selected reply text with a comment and send it with the next prompt

plan.title: Cite selected reply text with a comment and send it with the next prompt
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: To push back on part of an agent reply, the operator copies the text by hand and pastes it into the composer. There is no way to select a span, attach a comment, and send it with the next prompt.
narratives.Proposal: Add a Cite action for selected text in conversation messages. A floating Cite button (or the C key) opens a comment box; saved citations persist per conversation in localStorage and show as editable chips above the composer, with the quoted span highlighted via the CSS Custom Highlight API. On send, the client prepends an exactly-specified `Notes on your previous reply:` block to the prompt, so every harness receives identical text, and failed sends carry the citations into the outbox for Retry. No server change. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4642.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Citing inside the Stage BrowserPane (sandboxed iframe without allow-same-origin; belongs to #2685)
- Citing in the EditorPane markdown preview (no target conversation; follow-up #4658)
- Citing tool output, plan cards, choice cards, or streaming assistant text
- Any message pointer or link in the delivered text, or any use of the message-locator route
- Any server, @overdeck/contracts, or delivery-path change
- Changing composerStore echo reconciliation or attachment behavior when no citations are pending
- Cross-window live sync of pending citations (last write wins, like drafts)
- Disambiguating repeated text in the highlight (first occurrence is painted)
- Making attachments reload-durable (#1592)
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Serialize citations client-side into the message text (no server change).
autoDecisions.rationale: The outbox stores and Retry re-sends the composed text verbatim, so failed-send and Retry behavior come for free, and every harness receives identical bytes (issue AC).

autoDecisions.summary: Pin the exact block format: literal header `Notes on your previous reply:`, `n. > ` quote lines, continuation and comment lines indented to the prefix width, blank line before the prompt.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue gives a sketch; a pinned byte format makes tests and harness-equality checkable. The header string is the issue's own.

autoDecisions.summary: Attachments stay first, joined by a single newline as today; the citation block follows, then the prompt.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps attachment sends byte-identical when there are no citations.

autoDecisions.summary: Clear the chips once, right after the conversation-switch abort check, whenever citations were included.
autoDecisions.rationale: From that point the composed text always lands in a bubble, hold, offline hold, or the outbox, so the citations travel with that message; leaving chips pending after a failure would double-send them.

autoDecisions.summary: Slash-prefixed prompts (`/pan`, `/compact`, …) neither include nor consume citations; citations-only sends are allowed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Prepending text would break a slash command; mirrors the attachments-only send rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not put a message pointer in the delivered text; keep source.messageId client-side for the highlight.
autoDecisions.rationale: Answers the issue's open question: the agent cannot use a dashboard id, and the issue's format has none.

autoDecisions.summary: Only settled user and completed assistant message prose is citable; tool output is not.
autoDecisions.rationale: Answers the issue's open question with the smaller scope; tool rows have no stable text element and are not mentioned in the ACs.

autoDecisions.summary: Persist pending citations in localStorage key `conv-citations:<name>` (last write wins), hydrated synchronously.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for draft-like persistence; drafts use the same mechanism.

autoDecisions.summary: Highlight with the CSS Custom Highlight API from inside each row, first occurrence, best-effort.
autoDecisions.rationale: Paints without mutating React-owned DOM and survives virtualized row remounts; TypeScript 5.9 already types it.

autoDecisions.summary: Defer BrowserPane citing to #2685 and EditorPane preview citing to follow-up #4658; make PendingCitation.source a discriminated union so #2685 shares the list.
autoDecisions.rationale: The BrowserPane iframe has no allow-same-origin, so selection is unreadable; the EditorPane has no target conversation. Neither is in the issue's ACs.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract the attachment strip from ComposerFooter.tsx first.
autoDecisions.rationale: ComposerFooter.tsx is 982 lines against a 1000-line ceiling that agents may not raise.

In ComposerFooter.tsx render <ComposerAttachmentStrip attachments={pendingAttachments} onOpenImage={(attachment) => { lightboxOwnerRef.current = { id: attachment.id, src: attachment.previewUrl! }; openImageLightbox(attachment.previewUrl!, attachment.file.name); }} onRemove={removePendingAttachment} /> in the same place. Keep the lightbox-owner effect in ComposerFooter. Remove imports that become unused. Class names, titles and text stay identical: this is a pure move so later items (chips, send) fit under the 1000-line ceiling.

Add the per-conversation pending-citation store persisted in localStorage

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/composerCitations.ts: a zustand store { byConversation: Record<string, PendingCitation[]> } plus useConversationCitations(name), getConversationCitations(name), addCitation(name, { source, quotedText, comment }) (returns null for an empty trimmed quote; stores trimmed quote and comment, id = crypto.randomUUID(), createdAt = now ISO), updateCitationComment(name, id, comment), removeCitation(name, id), consumeCitations(name) (clears and removes the storage key), resetCitationStore() (test-only, rebuilds memory from localStorage). Every test file that touches the citation store runs `localStorage.clear(); resetCitationStore();` in beforeEach, because the reset now reloads from storage and happy-dom storage persists within a file. Storage key `conv-citations:<name>`, value JSON { v: 1, citations }; empty list removes the key. Hydrate once at store creation by iterating localStorage keys with prefix `conv-citations:` (never inside a selector or render, which would setState during render); resetCitationStore() re-runs that load to simulate a reload. Accept only v === 1 and well-formed entries with source.kind === 'message'; any parse/storage error reads as empty. Every storage call is wrapped in try/catch. Use a stable empty array for missing slices.

items.title: Given a saved citation for conversation `a`, when resetCitationStore() runs (reload simulation) and getConversationCitations('a') is read, then it returns the saved citation from localStorage key `conv-citations:a` with the same id, quote and comment

Given citations added to conversations `a` and `b`, when each list is read, then each returns only its own citations in add order, and consumeCitations('a') empties `a`, removes key `conv-citations:a`, and leaves `b` unchanged

Given localStorage.setItem throws, when addCitation runs, then it does not throw and the citation is still present in memory; and given corrupt JSON or `v: 2` in storage, when the list is read, then it returns an empty list
Given an added citation, when updateCitationComment and removeCitation run, then the comment changes in memory and storage, and the removed citation is absent from both

AssistantMessageRow: when citeConversationName is set and the row is not streaming-incomplete, wrap TurnBody in <div data-cite-message-id={message.id} data-cite-role="assistant">; changed-files card and metadata stay outside. MessagesTimeline.tsx: destructure citationsEnabled = false, pass citeConversationName={citationsEnabled ? conversationName : undefined} to both TimelineRowRenderer mounts, and render <CiteSelectionLayer conversationName rootRef={scrollContainerRef} /> once when enabled. ConversationPanel.tsx: add exactly one line `citationsEnabled={!hideComposer}` after `bookmarksEnabled` (file is at 1520 of a 1531 cap). One file components/chat/citations/CiteSelectionToolbar.tsx exports useCiteSelection, the presentational CiteSelectionToolbar({ conversationName, snapshot, onDone }) and CiteSelectionLayer({ conversationName, rootRef }) that joins them. useCiteSelection(rootRef): listen to document selectionchange + mouseup, resolve with resolveSelectionCitation, require the cite element inside rootRef.current, snapshot { messageId, role, quotedText, rect } (rect from getRangeAt(0).getBoundingClientRect()), clear on null or root scroll. CiteSelectionToolbar: portal to document.body; fixed `Cite` button at top = max(8, rect.top - 36), left clamped to [8, innerWidth - 64]; onMouseDown preventDefault; click or `c`/`C` (no Ctrl/Meta/Alt, activeElement not input/textarea/select/[contenteditable], listener only while button is visible) opens the box with a frozen snapshot: quote excerpt (160 chars + …), textarea aria-label `Citation comment` autofocus, Save and Cancel. Enter saves, Shift+Enter newline, Escape cancels. Save calls addCitation with source { kind: 'message', messageId, role }, then removeAllRanges and closes. Conversation change closes the box.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7. In ComposerFooter.tsx handleSubmit: after uploadedAttachments, compute `const citations = messageText.startsWith('/') ? [] : getConversationCitations(submitConversationName);`, change the early return to `if (!messageText && uploadedAttachments.length === 0 && citations.length === 0) return;`, and compose `const composedMessage = [attachmentPrefix, composePromptWithCitations(messageText, citations)].filter(Boolean).join('\n');`. Immediately after the conversation-switch abort check and before `if (isServerWriteBlocked())`, add `if (citations.length > 0) consumeCitations(submitConversationName);` (D6: the composed text carries the citations into the bubble, hold, offline hold or outbox; this intentionally differs from attachments, which stay pending on failure). narrative.Action: PRD WI-8. Create components/chat/citations/citationHighlight.ts (helpers, registry and hook in one file) with findQuoteRange(root, quote): TreeWalker over text nodes, compact string of non-whitespace chars with a parallel (node, offset) array, whitespace-stripped quote, first-occurrence indexOf mapped back to a Range, null when empty/not found; and a registry Map keyed `${conversationName}:${messageId}` with setRowCitationRanges(key, ranges) / clearRowCitationRanges(key) that, only when CSS.highlights and Highlight exist, sets `CSS.highlights.set('overdeck-citation', new Highlight(...allRanges))` or deletes the entry when no ranges remain. In the same file, useCitationHighlight(ref, conversationName, messageId): reads useConversationCitations, filters source.kind === 'message' && messageId match, computes ranges in useLayoutEffect (deps: filtered list, message text), clears on cleanup, returns whether the row has a pending citation. In messageRows.tsx put the hook in a small CitableText wrapper component used by the two cite wrappers from cite-row-gate (no conditional hooks) and set data-cited="true" when it returns true. index.css: `::highlight(overdeck-citation) { background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 22%, transparent); }`. TypeScript 5.9 lib.dom already types CSS.highlights; no ambient declaration.
